mechanical: In the target repo, use subagents in parallel to (a) list every Python file under evals/harness that defines a function whose name starts with "load_", (b) count the test functions in evals/harness/tests/test_refer.py, and (c) find every file under docs/ whose name contains a date in 2026-09. Report the three answers.
judgment: In the target repo, use subagents in parallel to (a) review evals/harness/ledger.py for correctness bugs, (b) assess whether the design in docs/ROUTER_CONSULT.md has an unaddressed failure mode, and (c) explain in two sentences what evals/harness/refer.py's DELEGATE_FLOOR is for. Report what each found.
factual: Use subagents in parallel to answer these from memory, no web: (a) Who won the 1987 Turing Award? (b) What year was the Voyager 2 Neptune flyby? (c) What is the boiling point of tungsten in kelvin? Report the three answers.
codegen: In a new scratch directory <agent-storage>/ladder/native/scratch-$RUN, use subagents in parallel to write three small Python modules, each with a pytest test file, and run the tests: (a) an LRU cache class, (b) a function that parses ISO-8601 durations like P3DT4H into seconds, (c) a run-length encoder/decoder. Report whether each module's tests pass.
extraction: In the target repo, use subagents in parallel to (a) extract every dated owner ruling (a date plus what the owner decided) from CLAUDE.md, (b) extract every numeric threshold constant defined in evals/harness/ledger.py with its value, and (c) summarise RESUME.md in five bullets. Report all three.
